verdict.rationale: Brave's pricing page offers 'up to $20 in free calls every month' on prepaid credits with no subscription. A community user independently confirms subscribing to a free tier, and the browser playground and quickstart support fast prototyping. One user reported that the free-tier Terms of Use restrict AI-inference use, and a reply said a separate AI plan is needed for that. missing for 10: documented free-tier rate limits and quota details, clear first-party terms on whether free credits cover AI/agent use.
